scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmmm...
You must have come,
sensing that someone
is waiting for you here.
Tell me, do you seek
the path of patience?
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯...
你一定是察覺到有人在這裡等你，才過來的吧。
告訴我，你是否在追尋忍耐之道？

scripts.text: No
scripts.translation: 不是

scripts.text: Yes
scripts.translation: 是的

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
I see.
To each his own,
I suppose. Take
care of yourself.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
我明白了。
人各有志吧。
保重。

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Very well.
Then, let me
set you on that
path right away...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
很好。
那就讓我即刻引你踏上這條路...

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hm? I cannot be
of any service to
you until you grow
a little stronger...
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯？等你再強一些，我才能幫你...

scripts.text:
[Akagi]
Hmm...
You and I...
We are fairly equal in
terms of combat ability.
Perhaps we can spar
together sometime.
scripts.translation:
[赤木]
嗯...
你我實力相當。
或許哪天可以切磋一下。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I... I've never
seen a baby as
powerful as you!
G-get away, you
freak of nature!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
我...我從沒見過這麼強的嬰兒！
走...走開，你這個怪胎！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Have you come to
learn how to be a Ninja?
You're not quite experienced
enough yet, so come back
after you're more familiar
with fighting monsters.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
嗯？你是來學習忍術的嗎？
你的經驗還不夠，等你更熟悉與魔物戰鬥，再來吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Excuse me.
H-hello?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
打擾一下。
你...你好？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
...............................
How did you do that?

[{0}]
Do what? I didn't
do anything, I don't think...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
做什麼？我好像什麼都沒做啊...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
H-How are you able to
see me? I'm supposed to
be invisible to the naked eye.
Ah, now I get it. Wildcat Joe
must have sent you to kill me! I won't fall for your tricks! Die!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
你...你怎麼能看見我？
我應該是肉眼看不見的啊。
啊，我明白了！一定是野貓喬派你來殺我的！
我才不會上當！受死吧！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
W-wait! I-I don't even
know who Wildcat Joe is!
Calm down, there's no
need to get violent!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
等...等等！我...我連野貓喬是誰都不知道！
冷靜點，沒必要動手啊！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How did you dodge
all of my attacks?
You've got some talent,
I'll give you that.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
什麼...？
你竟然躲開了我所有的攻擊？
不得不承認，你確實有些天賦。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
...............................
I came here hoping
to change my job
to a Ninja.

[Kuuga Gai]
...Oh. Is that all?
Hmm, you've got great
potential, but I can't help
you now. I've got too many
enemies, and I can't let my
guard down for even a second.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
...哦，就這事？
嗯，你很有潛力，但我現在幫不了你。
我的敵人太多，一刻也不能放鬆警惕。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
That Wildcat Joe is
completely ruthless...!
He could strike at any time!
He'll do anything to achieve
victory over his enemies!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
那個野貓喬心狠手辣...！
他隨時可能出手！
為了打敗敵人，他什麼手段都用得出來！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Wait, wait, I just
thought of something.
Maybe you can help me out.
Do what I ask, and I'll teach
you a few of my skills if you
really want to be a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
等等，等等，我想到個辦法。
也許你能幫我。
如果你真想成為忍者，就照我說的做，我會教你幾招。

scripts.text: Sure.
scripts.translation: 好

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hm? Well, alright.
Still, I don't see
why we can't help
each other in this
little predicament...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
嗯？那好吧。
不過，眼下這點麻煩，咱們互相幫忙不就解決了嗎...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Great! Now, I wanted to
ask Wildcat Joe if he'd
agree to a temporary truce.
I'm aware that both of us
are out of weapons, so we
should get well equipped first.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
太好了！我想問問野貓喬，願不願意暫時休戰。
據我所知，我們倆都沒武器了，得先補充裝備。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Please take this letter,
and deliver it to Wildcat
Joe in Einbroch. He's a master
of disguise, so keep a careful
eye out for him. Ah, and look
for him in a high place.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
拿著這封信，交給艾音布羅克的野貓喬。
他是個偽裝高手，找的時候得留心。
啊，對了，去高處找他。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Yeah, Wildcat Joe
always did have a thing
for hiding in high places.
Anyway, after you give him
the letter, come back and
let me know his answer.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
沒錯，野貓喬一直喜歡藏在高處。
把信交給他後，就回來告訴我他的答覆。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Even if this task
isn't that urgent,
please hurry over to
Einbroch and deliver
my letter to Wildcat Joe.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
雖然這事不算特別急，還是請你儘快去艾音布羅克，把信交給野貓喬。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Did you deliver that
letter to Wildcat Joe?
I still need to know his
response to my proposal
for a truce. Anyway, see
if you can needle him for it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
信交給野貓喬了嗎？
我還等著他對休戰提議的答覆呢。
總之，去催催他吧。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you've returned.
So did Wildcat Joe send
you back here with his
response? Great, great,
please let me read it.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
啊，你回來了。
野貓喬讓你帶回了答覆？
太好了，快給我看看。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?! How could he
reject my proposal for
a truce?! This can only
mean that he's made another
Kunai. Nuts! I have to catch
up to him, or I'm a goner!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
什麼...？！他竟然拒絕休戰？！
這隻能說明，他又做出苦無了。
該死！我得趕緊跟上，不然就完了！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Listen, you've got to help
me out again! I need you to
gather some materials so that
I can craft my own Kunai to fight Wildcat Joe. Then, I'll go ahead
and change your job to a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
聽著，你得再幫我一次！
去收集些材料，我要打造自己的苦無，對付野貓喬。
然後，我就讓你轉職為忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
All you need
to bring me is
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
Please get those
as quickly as you can!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
只需要帶來^3355FF5個賽依伐^000000和^3355FF1個強化武器金屬-級數一^000000。
越快越好！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? That's funny,
Wildcat Joe actually
asked me to gather
those same materials.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？這就怪了，野貓喬也讓我收集同樣的材料。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Curses! Then that means...
You actually helped Joe
in crafting his Kunai! No!
I should have thought about
that earlier! Well, it's too
late now. Just h-hurry it up!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
該死！這麼說...
你居然幫喬做出了苦無！不！
我早該想到的！
算了，現在說什麼都晚了，快...快去！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Hurry and bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me,
so that I can craft
my own Kunai to use
against Wildcat Joe!
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
快帶來^3355FF5個賽依伐^000000和^3355FF1個強化武器金屬-級數一^000000，我要打造自己的苦無，對付野貓喬！

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Whoa, whoa...
You still have some
leftover Skill Points.
You'd better spend all
of them before you
change jobs, right?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
等等，等等...
你還有沒分配的技能點。
轉職之前，得先把它們用完，對吧？

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Ah, you're back with
everything that I need.
You've come earlier than
I expected, eh? Great,
as promised, I'll turn
you into a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
啊，需要的東西都帶回來了。
比我預想的還快啊！
很好，按約定，我會讓你轉職為忍者。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Let me formally introduce
myself. I am High Ninja Kuuga Gai
in the Touga Ninja Corps, and
I'm in charge of the search
party to find Sir Kazma.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
正式介紹一下，我是土加忍者軍團的上忍空牙·蓋，負責率領尋找卡茲馬大人的搜查隊。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
Sir Kazma is the chief
of my village, but he's
run away. This has resulted
in an internal conflict within
the Ninja Corps. Things are
pretty unstable right now...
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
卡茲馬大人是我們村子的首領，可他出走了。
這導致忍者軍團內部起了紛爭，眼下局勢很不穩定...

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
I initially didn't want to
accept you as a Ninja because
of this complicated situation.
However, you've proven that
you're truly worthy of joining
the Ninja ranks.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
正因為局勢複雜，我起初不想收你做忍者。
不過，你已經證明自己確實有資格加入我們。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
According to his letter, even
Joe thinks highly of you. Just
remember that, as a Ninja, your
mission is your highest priority. But don't let mission objectives
supersede your conscience.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
從回信來看，連喬也很看好你。
記住，身為忍者，要把任務放在首位。
但絕不能為了完成任務，違背自己的良心。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
''Secrecy above all else.''
To keep our secrets in the
shadows, you can only buy
or sell Ninja weapons with
authorized dealers. Please
keep that in mind.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
“保密高於一切。”
為了不洩露我們的秘密，你只能與指定商人買賣忍者武器。
務必記住。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
As of today, you are
now a proud member of the
Touga Ninja Corps. Be as
agile as the wind, and as
quiet as the falling shadows.
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
從今天起，你就是土加忍者軍團光榮的一員。
行動如疾風，潛行如暗影。

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
最近怎麼樣？
努力修煉，要做到來去無蹤。
能做到這一點，就能贏得所有忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
How have you been?
Train hard: you want
to be able to vanish
without a trace. If you
can do that, you'll get
the respect of any Ninja~
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
最近怎麼樣？
努力修煉，要做到來去無蹤。
能做到這一點，就能贏得所有忍者的尊重~

scripts.text:
[Kuuga Gai]
What...?
How were you able
to find me hidden
in the shadows?!
You must be more than
a common adventurer, eh?
scripts.translation:
[空牙·蓋]
什麼...？
我藏在陰影裡，你怎麼還能找到我？！
看來你不是普通的冒險者啊。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
我遊歷過許多國家，卻從沒登上過像艾音布羅克中央塔這麼高的建築。
相比之下，家鄉的建築都顯得很矮小...

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Oh, are you from
Amatsu? I'm looking
for someone named
Wildcat Joe from there.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
哦，你來自櫻花城嗎？
我正在找那裡的一個人，叫野貓喬。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...No. No, I'm actually
from Izlude, and I'm only
here in Einbroch for some
minerals. Tell me, why are
you looking for this Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...不，不，我其實來自依斯魯得島，只是來艾音布羅克找些礦石。
你為什麼要找這個野貓喬？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well, I need to deliver
this letter to him and
get his response so that
I can become a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我得把這封信交給他，再帶回他的答覆，才能成為忍者。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Really? Now that I think
about it, I do think that I've
run once or twice into him
in this town. Though, he prefers to be called ''Red Leopard Joe,''
instead of ''Wildcat Joe.''
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
是嗎？這麼一想，我好像確實在城裡遇見過他一兩次。
不過，比起“野貓喬”，他更喜歡別人叫他“紅豹 喬”。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
I really want to help you
find him, but first I need
to find the minerals that
I'm looking for. If you don't
mind, would you help me?
Then I can help you find Joe.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
我倒是很想幫你找他，可得先找到我要的礦石。
如果不介意，能幫我個忙嗎？
這樣我就能幫你找喬了。

scripts.text: Don't worry, I'll find him alone.
scripts.translation: 不用擔心，我自己找

scripts.text: Sure, I'll help you.
scripts.translation: 好，我幫你

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
You sure about that...?
Red Leopard Joe is a true
master of disguise. You'll
need all the help you can
get to find him...
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
你確定...？
紅豹 喬可是個真正的偽裝高手。
想找到他，你得儘可能找人幫忙...

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Great, I'm glad to
hear that. Please
help me find
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
太好了！請幫我找來^3355FF5個賽依伐^000000和^3355FF1個強化武器金屬-級數一^000000。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Please bring
^3355FF5 Cyfars^000000 and
^3355FF1 Phracon^000000 to me as
soon as you can. Then,
I can help you find
Red Leopard Joe.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
請儘快帶來^3355FF5個賽依伐^000000和^3355FF1個強化武器金屬-級數一^000000。
然後，我就能幫你找紅豹 喬。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Good, good. You've
brought the minerals...
Now, it's my turn to
help you now. Here,
let me see that letter.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
很好，很好，礦石帶來了...
現在輪到我幫你了，把那封信給我看看。

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
Why? Didn't you bring Kuuga Gai's letter for me?
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
怎麼了？你不是給我帶了空牙·蓋的信嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Are you...
Are you Wildcat Joe?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
你...你就是野貓喬？

scripts.text:
[Suspicious Man]
...Yes, but I prefer to
be called Red Leopard Joe.
Kuuga Gai sent you to me, right?
He's the only one who calls
me that. So you want to be
a Ninja, eh? Hmm, alright.
scripts.translation:
[可疑的男子]
...沒錯，不過我更喜歡“紅豹 喬”這個名字。
是空牙·蓋讓你來的吧？只有他才那樣叫我。
你想成為忍者，是嗎？嗯，好吧。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
If you want to be a Ninja,
you should always be careful
of what you see and what you trust. Don't forget that if your
secrets are ever discovered, then you're finished as a Ninja.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
想成為忍者，就要時刻警惕，不要輕信眼前所見。
記住，秘密一旦暴露，你的忍者生涯就結束了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Remember to move
quickly, and to always
vanish without a trace.
To remain hidden in the
shadows is really our
ultimate power.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
記住，行動要快，隱去時不能留下任何痕跡。
藏身於暗影之中，才是我們最強大的力量。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
For now, let me read
this letter. Let's see...
Hm. I thought that Kuuga Gai
would want to challenge me
again, but he actually wants
a temporary truce? Hah!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
先讓我看看這封信吧...
嗯，我還以為空牙·蓋又想挑戰我，沒想到他居然想暫時休戰？哈！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Thanks to your help,
I now have the minerals
I need to construct a Kunai!
Hahaha! I won't agree to a truce when I have the advantage!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
多虧你幫忙，我已經湊齊了打造苦無的礦石！
哈哈哈！既然佔了上風，我怎麼會同意休戰！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Anyway, let me write my
response to him. I'll also
give you my recommendation...
I think you'll make a very fine
Ninja, even if I did trick you
just earlier. Heh heh heh!
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
總之，我先給他寫封回信，也會向他推薦你...
雖然你剛才被我騙了，但我覺得，你會成為一個很出色的忍者。
嘿嘿嘿！

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Here you go.
Please bring this
letter to Kuuga Gai.
It'll take a while to
return to Amatsu, so let
me send you there directly...
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
給，把這封信交給空牙·蓋。
回櫻花城還要花些時間，我就直接送你過去吧...

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Eh? I'm not sure what
happened, but it seems
that you haven't delivered
my response to Kuuga Gai yet.
Shall I directly send you
to Amatsu right now?
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
咦？不知道出了什麼事，你好像還沒把我的回信交給空牙·蓋。
要我現在直接送你去櫻花城嗎？

scripts.text: No, thanks.
scripts.translation: 不了，謝謝

scripts.text: Yes, please.
scripts.translation: 好，麻煩你了

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Alright. Well, I was
just trying to save
you some time.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
好吧，我只是想替你省點時間。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Okay, then.
Goodbye for now.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
好，那就先告別了。

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Kuuga Gai asked you to
gather some materials
too? Oh well, I suppose
that I can't blame him.
Besides, I should be able
to beat him in a fair fight~
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
空牙·蓋也讓你收集材料？
算了，倒也不能怪他。
反正公平交手，我也能打敗他~

scripts.text:
[Red Leopard Joe]
Oh, you're a Ninja~
I hope you continue to
train yourself and master
all the Ninja skills that
you can. Always remember
to blend into the shadows.
scripts.translation:
[紅豹 喬]
哦，你已經是忍者了~
希望你繼續修煉，儘可能掌握各種忍術。
別忘了，時刻融入暗影之中。

scripts.text:
[Tourist]
I've traveled to many
countries, but I've never
been on a building as high
as Einbroch Tower. All the
buildings in my hometown
are tiny in comparison...
scripts.translation:
[遊客]
我遊歷過許多國家，卻從沒登上過像艾音布羅克中央塔這麼高的建築。
相比之下，家鄉的建築都顯得很矮小...
